rows.sourceEnglish: Compacted soil loses its air spaces. Roots slow down. Water soaks in differently. The bed gets harder to work every season.
rows.beforeTarget: Compacted soil loses its air spaces. Midzi i aluwa nga u ongolowa. Maḓi a nwela nga nḓila yo fhambanaho. Bed gets harder to work kha khalaṅwaha iṅwe na iṅwe.
rows.afterTarget: Mavu o petetsanaho a xedza zwikhala zwa muya. Midzi i aluwa nga u ongolowa. Maḓi a nwela nga nḓila yo fhambanaho. Bed gets harder to work kha khalaṅwaha iṅwe na iṅwe.
